body.construction: Saturate context-compatible \(Q\)-factor recovery while carrying original observed-cell provenance and quotient row labels; retain every nonrepeating partial deletion trace; for each residual district extract rooted C-forest candidates and test whether their quotient-supported perturbation spaces survive all observed contractions before attempting multi-block gluing.
